visibleTestCases.title: Quota Enforcement & Token Consumption
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, S} = rate_limiter_srv:start_link(10, 3), {allow, 7} = rate_limiter_srv:check_request(S, <<"client_a">>, 3), Res = rate_limiter_srv:check_request(S, <<"client_a">>, 5), rate_limiter_srv:stop(S), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Deducts 3 and 5 tokens from 10 capacity, leaving 2 tokens.

visibleTestCases.title: Denial When Cost Exceeds Remaining Tokens
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, S} = rate_limiter_srv:start_link(10, 3), {allow, 2} = rate_limiter_srv:check_request(S, <<"client_b">>, 8), Res = rate_limiter_srv:check_request(S, <<"client_b">>, 5), rate_limiter_srv:stop(S), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Denies request when 5 tokens are requested but only 2 remain.

visibleTestCases.title: Batch Refill All Clients
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, S} = rate_limiter_srv:start_link(10, 3), {allow, 0} = rate_limiter_srv:check_request(S, <<"client_c">>, 10), rate_limiter_srv:refill_all(S), Res = rate_limiter_srv:check_request(S, <<"client_c">>, 2), rate_limiter_srv:stop(S), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Refills tokens and caps strictly at max_tokens.
